changes.old: The ACCC has prepared a questionnaire on the Acquisition. Submissions or information in response to the questionnaire should be provided by 14 September 2026 via email to mergers@accc.gov.au with the title Submission re: Flick - GC Pest Control. The ACCC's ability to give detailed consideration to submissions received after this time may be limited. Open date 7 Sep 2026 Closing date 14 Sep 2026
changes.new: The period for providing submissions or information in response to the ACCC’s questionnaire has concluded.
